mechanism: Show a sealed carrier being admitted through a visible external process, place it intact inside a trusted bounded space, preserve its identity through a readable delay or ambient-state change, let it visibly open only after entry with no opening operator shown, then let concealed contents emerge and create an environment-scale consequence. The source does not prove the hidden actuation method; the mechanism is independent of warfare, animals, cities, fire or paper craft.

invariants.rule: Use a visible external process to admit one sealed carrier through a trusted boundary.
invariants.purpose: Makes entry causal rather than magical.
invariants.ablation_failure: A carrier that simply appears inside has no admission proof.

invariants.rule: Establish the carrier intact and inert inside the bounded destination.
invariants.purpose: Creates trust and postpones the reveal.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening during entry removes the delayed-release premise.

invariants.rule: Preserve carrier identity and location through one readable delay or ambient-state change.
invariants.ablation_failure: No delay makes the result an ordinary delivery.

invariants.rule: Open the carrier only after the delay, show no opening operator and let concealed contents emerge.
invariants.purpose: Reverses the trusted object's visible role without inventing an actuation cause.
invariants.ablation_failure: Contents visible before the delayed opening remove the concealed-release turn.

invariants.rule: Let the released contents produce one visible environment-scale consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: A local exit without a wider consequence leaves the carrier function unproven.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source cardboard Trojan horse and ancient city walls
the source black paper soldiers, ropes and gate entry
the source paper-cut war staging and day-to-night square
the source internal ramp, troop emergence and city fire

instantiations.concept: In an original glasshouse at dusk, an automated floor conveyor admits one sealed ceramic seed vault through an airlock and parks it among closed plants. After the grow lights shift to night, timed latches release with no operator visible, small luminous pollination drones emerge and a wave of blooms crosses the whole greenhouse.
